31	
32	/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/
33	
34	/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
35	inductive KernelOp where
36	  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
37	  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
38	  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
39	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
40	  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
41	  | release (a : Nat)
42	  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
43	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
44	  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
45	  | depend (q x : Nat)
46	  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
47	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
48	  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
49	  | exit
50	  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
51	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
52	  /-- O10 `write` (§67). -/
53	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
54	  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68). -/
55	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
56	  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
57	  | pin (p : Nat)
58	  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75). -/
59	  | unpin (p : Nat)
60	  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
61	  | endUse (p : Nat)
62	  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
63	  | free (p auth : Nat)
64	  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
65	  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
66	  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
67	  | store (a p : Nat)

69	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
70	def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
71	  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
72	  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
73	  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
74	  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
75	  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
76	  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
77	  | .exit => ExitStep k
78	  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
79	  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
80	  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
81	  | .pin p => PinStep p
82	  | .unpin p => UnpinStep k p
83	  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
84	  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
85	  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
86	  | .store a p => StoreStep a p
87	
88	/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
89	theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
90	  constructor
91	  · intro h
92	    cases h with
93	    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
94	    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
95	    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
96	    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
97	    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
98	    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
99	    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
100	    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
101	    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
102	    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
103	    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
104	    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
105	    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
106	    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
107	    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
108	    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
109	  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
110	    cases op with
111	    | derive => exact .derive h
112	    | split => exact .split h
113	    | release => exact .release h
114	    | transfer => exact .transfer h
115	    | depend => exact .depend h
116	    | enter => exact .enter h
117	    | exit => exact .exit h
118	    | read => exact .read h
119	    | write => exact .write h
120	    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
121	    | pin => exact .pin h
122	    | unpin => exact .unpin h
123	    | endUse => exact .endUse h
124	    | free => exact .free h
125	    | alloc => exact .alloc h
126	    | store => exact .store h
127	
128	/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
129	inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
130	  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
131	  | refl : KStar k s s
132	  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
133	  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u
134	
135	/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
136	kernel steps. -/
137	theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
138	    Reachable k statics s ↔ KStar k (S3.init statics) s := by
139	  constructor
140	  · intro h
141	    induction h with
142	    | init => exact .refl
143	    | step _ h ih => exact .tail ih h
144	  · intro h
145	    induction h with
146	    | refl => exact .init
147	    | tail _ h ih => exact .step ih h
148	
149	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/
150	
151	/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
152	theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
153	    ∃ pr ow ls, op = .alloc pr ow ls := by
154	  cases op with
155	  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
156	  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim
157	
158	/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
159	theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
160	  cases h with
161	  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
162	  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
163	  | release h =>
164	    rename_i a
165	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
166	    unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
167	  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
168	  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
169	  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
170	  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
171	  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
172	  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
173	  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
174	  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
175	  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
176	  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
177	  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
178	  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
179	  | store h =>
180	    rename_i a p
181	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
182	    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl
183	
184	/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
185	theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
186	    s.F.getLast? = some 0 := by
187	  induction h with
188	  | init => rfl
189	  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih
190	
191	/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
192	theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
193	    0 ∈ s.F :=
194	  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)
195	
196	/-! ## Preservation by every step except `transfer` (§57, §58) -/
197	
198	/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) from its `ok` outcome, under
199	`DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
200	theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
201	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) : KInv s' := by
202	  cases op with
203	  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
204	  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
205	  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
206	  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
207	  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
208	  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
209	  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
210	  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
211	  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
212	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
213	  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
214	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
215	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
216	  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
217	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
218	  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h
219	
220	/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40,
221	§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
222	outcome. -/
223	theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
224	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
225	  cases op with
226	  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
227	  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
228	  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
229	  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
230	  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
231	  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
232	  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
233	  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
234	  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h
235	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_kAux haux h
236	  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
237	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
238	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
239	  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
240	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
241	  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
242	
243	/-- Every kernel step from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) under `DDSound` (§80) either preserves
244	`KInv` or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception (`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
245	theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
246	    (h : KStep k s s') : KInv s' ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') := by

248	  cases op with

251

253	(§57) and `KAux`. -/

255	    (h : KStep k s s') : KAux s' := by
256	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
257	  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

264	private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
265	    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →

271	  · exact h
272	  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this

275	/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by

277	private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
278	    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
279	  by_cases hx : x < l.length
280	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
281	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

283	/-- Every operation preserves `HeldAnchored` from a `WF3` state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new

285	`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
286	anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
287	places whose authorities stay active. -/

291	  | derive src region m =>
292	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
293	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
294	    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
295	    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
296	    · cases hhq
297	  | split src rs =>
298	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
299	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
300	    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
301	    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
302	    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; cases hhq
303	  | release a =>
304	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
305	    cases hx₀ : s.A[a]? with
306	    | none => simp only [releaseEff, hx₀]; exact hh
307	    | some x₀ =>
308	      rw [releaseEff_eq hx₀]
309	      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
310	      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx₀)] at hy
311	      split at hy
312	      · cases hy; cases ya
313	      · rename_i hax
314	        refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
315	        simp only
316	        split
317	        · exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, by simpa using fun e => hax e.symm⟩

319	  | transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh h

322	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq,
323	      fun _ hx => ?_⟩
324	    simp only [dependEff]
325	    split
326	    · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
327	    · exact hx
328	  | enter ps ls =>
329	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

331	    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
332	    · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy

336	      · subst e

340	        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)
341	        · exact hx
342	    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
343	  | exit =>
344	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
345	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_

347	    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
348	    unfold exitG at e
349	    split at e
350	    · rename_i hsv
351	      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by
352	        unfold Survives at hsv; rw [hy₀] at hsv; exact hsv.1
353	      split at e
354	      · subst e; exact absurd ‹_› ho
355	      · rename_i o ho₀
356	        subst e
357	        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, (by rw [ho₀]; exact fun h => by cases h), hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
358	        simp only [exitEff]
359	        refine List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
360	        show (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x = x
361	        rw [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (p := fun z => decide (Survives s s.F.tail z))

364	    · subst e; cases ya
365	  | read a ls =>
366	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact hh
367	  | write a ls =>

370	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
371	  | writeShared a ls =>

373	    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
374	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩

392	    · exact hx

395	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_

403	      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
404	        show x ∈ (if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q)
405	        split
406	        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)
407	        · exact hx
408	      · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho

422	      split at hy
423	      · rename_i e; subst e; cases hy
424	        cases hhq
425	        exact .inl (by simp)
426	      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
427	        simp only
428	        split
429	        · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx

432	/-- `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every kernel step from a `WF3` state (§44, §49, §57). -/
433	theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
434	    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
435	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
436	  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop

440	/-- After an accepted `transfer` (§63) from a `WF3` state (§49), `NoDangling` (§54) of the
441	resulting state forces the destination to be usable: an authority of the current frame with
442	`Modify` over the destination (§63.1) still covers its leaves. -/
443	theorem transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
444	    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hnd : NoDangling s') : s'.Usable dst := by
445	  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
446	  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => ?_
447	  obtain ⟨a, -, -, hall⟩ := hpre.dstRight
448	  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - dst + 1) dst (by omega)
449	    hpre.dstUsable.lt
450	  have hal := hall l hl
451	  cases he : effective s a l with
452	  | none => rw [he] at hal; exact hal
453	  | some e =>
454	    obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hlx, -⟩ := effective_some he
455	    have hx' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some (if heldIn s.P src x.holder then
456	        { x with holder := mvTo s.P src dst x.holder } else x) := by
457	      rw [transfer_A_get, hx]; rfl
458	    exact hnd a _ hx' (by split <;> exact xa) dst hu l (by rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hl)
459	      (by split <;> exact hlx)

461	/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary, not a clause of §63 nor of
462	§57), an accepted `transfer` (§63) preserves `KInv` iff its destination is usable in the resulting
463	state. The destination usable afterwards is not a clause of §63 (`transfer_breaks_kinv`); this
464	states exactly when §57 holds after the step. -/
465	theorem transfer_kinv_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
466	    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
467	    KInv s' ↔ s'.Usable dst :=
468	  ⟨fun hk => transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling hinv.1 h hk.2.1.2.2,
469	    transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored hinv hheld h⟩

471	/-- Every operation, `transfer` included when its destination stays usable (a hypothesis, not a
472	clause of §63), preserves `KInv` (§57) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary) under `DDSound` (§80). -/
473	theorem op_preserves_of_dst_usable {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
474	    (hinv : KInv s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s'))
475	    (hdu : ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst) :
476	    KInv s' ∧ HeldAnchored s' := by
477	  have hh' := op_preserves_heldAnchored hinv.1 hheld h
478	  cases op with
479	  | transfer src dst => exact ⟨(transfer_kinv_iff hinv hheld h).2 (hdu src dst rfl), hh'⟩
480	  | _ => exact ⟨op_preserves hdd hinv h fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e, hh'⟩

484	/-- The places of `S3.init statics` are the declared statics (§47). -/
485	private theorem initP_len (statics : Statics) : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by
486	  simp [S3.init, shapeP]

488	/-- The place of a static (§47): its declared parent, its owner (the owning static or frame 0),
489	its kind. -/
490	private theorem initP_get {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < statics.length) :
491	    (S3.init statics).P[i]? = some ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1),
492	      shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i,
493	      (((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
494	  simp only [S3.init, shapeP, List.nil_append, List.getElem?_map,
495	    List.getElem?_range (show i < (statics.map (·.1)).length by simpa using hi)]
496	  rfl

498	/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§47). -/
499	private theorem initP_get' {statics : Statics} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
500	    (h : (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl) : q < statics.length ∧
501	      pl = ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.1),
502	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) q,
503	        (((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
504	  have hq : q < statics.length := by have := lt_of_getElem? h; rwa [initP_len] at this
505	  rw [initP_get hq] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hq, rfl⟩

508	private theorem initA_get {statics : Statics} {j : Nat} {z : Authority}
509	    (h : (S3.init statics).A[j]? = some z) : ∃ i, (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i ∧
510	      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P i,
511	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩ := by
512	  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at h
513	  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h

517	private theorem rootIdx_get {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j i : Nat}
518	    (h : (rootIdx ls)[j]? = some i) : i < ls.length ∧ (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
519	  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
520	  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this

523	/-- The parent of a static is an earlier static with the same owner (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
524	private theorem statics_parent {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i r : Nat}
525	    (hi : i < statics.length) (hr : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) :

527	  have h1 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).1
528	  rw [hr] at h1
529	  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := h1
530	  exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

533	private theorem statics_owner {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i o : Nat}

535	  have h2 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).2
536	  rw [ho] at h2
537	  have := h2.2

540	/-- Every static is usable in the initial state (§40, §47): its owners lead to frame 0. -/
541	private theorem init_usable {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
542	    ∀ n i, i < n → i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i
543	  | 0, _, hn, _ => absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
544	  | n + 1, i, hn, hi => by
545	    have hpl := initP_get hi
546	    cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
547	    | none =>
548	      exact .frame (f := 0) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (List.mem_singleton_self _)
549	    | some o =>
550	      have := statics_owner h hi ho
551	      exact .place (o := o) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (init_usable h n o (by omega)
552	        (by omega))

567	  have hi : i < statics.length := by simpa using hil

574	    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i)
575	    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=

580	theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
581	    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
582	  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
583	    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
584	  have hof : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
585	      pl.owner = .frame f → f < (S3.init statics).nF := by
586	    intro q pl f hq ho
587	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
588	    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
589	    split at ho
590	    · cases ho
591	    · cases ho; exact Nat.zero_lt_one
592	  have hop : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
593	      pl.owner = .place o → o < (S3.init statics).P.length := by
594	    intro q pl o hq ho
595	    obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
596	    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
597	    split at ho
598	    · rename_i o' ho'
599	      cases ho
600	      rw [initP_len]; exact Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hql ho') hql
601	    · cases ho
602	  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
603	    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
604	    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
605	      obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
606	      obtain ⟨hrq, hown⟩ := statics_parent hst hql hp
607	      exact ⟨_, initP_get (by omega), hrq, by simp only [shapeOwner, hown], rfl⟩
608	    owners := ⟨hof, hop, fun _ hq => hq.frameOf⟩
609	    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
610	      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
611	      exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
612	    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by

  (1) témoin complet depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés : newPool, allocSlot, resolve Modify, écriture, transfer de la valeur vers un local de même forme, unresolve, freeSlot accepté ;

8	/-!
9	# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant
10	
11	Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
12	§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`:
13	
14	* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
15	  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
16	* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step except `transfer` (§63), and for `transfer` the
17	  exact condition: on states satisfying the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`, the step preserves `KInv`
18	  iff the destination is usable afterwards; separately, preservation of the auxiliary `KAux` by
19	  every step;
20	* `HeldAnchored` holds initially and is preserved by every step from a `WF3` state;
21	* the initial state satisfies the invariant under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its `Init` leaves are the
22	  declared ones;
23	* the main invariant on reachable states (§57) is false as stated (`reachable_kinv_false`); it
24	  holds on runs whose transfers keep the destination usable (`reachableDU_kinv`);
25	* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
26	  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
27	  fails.
28	-/

32	/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/
33	
34	/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
35	inductive KernelOp where
36	  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
37	  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
38	  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
39	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
40	  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
41	  | release (a : Nat)
42	  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
43	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
44	  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
45	  | depend (q x : Nat)
46	  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
47	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
48	  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
49	  | exit
50	  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
51	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
52	  /-- O10 `write` (§67). -/
53	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
54	  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68). -/
55	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
56	  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
57	  | pin (p : Nat)
58	  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75). -/
59	  | unpin (p : Nat)
60	  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
61	  | endUse (p : Nat)
62	  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
63	  | free (p auth : Nat)
64	  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
65	  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
66	  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
67	  | store (a p : Nat)
68	
69	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
70	def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
71	  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
72	  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
73	  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
74	  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
75	  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
76	  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
77	  | .exit => ExitStep k
78	  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
79	  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
80	  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
81	  | .pin p => PinStep p
82	  | .unpin p => UnpinStep k p
83	  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
84	  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
85	  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
86	  | .store a p => StoreStep a p
87	
88	/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
89	theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
90	  constructor
91	  · intro h
92	    cases h with
93	    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
94	    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
95	    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
96	    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
97	    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
98	    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
99	    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
100	    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
101	    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
102	    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
103	    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
104	    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
105	    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
106	    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
107	    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
108	    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
109	  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
110	    cases op with
111	    | derive => exact .derive h
112	    | split => exact .split h
113	    | release => exact .release h
114	    | transfer => exact .transfer h
115	    | depend => exact .depend h
116	    | enter => exact .enter h
117	    | exit => exact .exit h
118	    | read => exact .read h
119	    | write => exact .write h
120	    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
121	    | pin => exact .pin h
122	    | unpin => exact .unpin h
123	    | endUse => exact .endUse h
124	    | free => exact .free h
125	    | alloc => exact .alloc h
126	    | store => exact .store h
127	
128	/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
129	inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
130	  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
131	  | refl : KStar k s s
132	  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
133	  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u
134	
135	/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
136	kernel steps. -/
137	theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
138	    Reachable k statics s ↔ KStar k (S3.init statics) s := by
139	  constructor
140	  · intro h
141	    induction h with
142	    | init => exact .refl
143	    | step _ h ih => exact .tail ih h
144	  · intro h
145	    induction h with
146	    | refl => exact .init
147	    | tail _ h ih => exact .step ih h

149	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/
150	
151	/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
152	theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
153	    ∃ pr ow ls, op = .alloc pr ow ls := by
154	  cases op with
155	  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
156	  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim
157	
158	/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
159	theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
160	  cases h with
161	  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
162	  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
163	  | release h =>
164	    rename_i a
165	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
166	    unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
167	  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
168	  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
169	  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
170	  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
171	  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
172	  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
173	  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
174	  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
175	  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
176	  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
177	  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
178	  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
179	  | store h =>
180	    rename_i a p
181	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
182	    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl
183	
184	/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
185	theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
186	    s.F.getLast? = some 0 := by
187	  induction h with
188	  | init => rfl
189	  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih
190	
191	/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
192	theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
193	    0 ∈ s.F :=
194	  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)

196	/-! ## Preservation by every step except `transfer` (§57, §58) -/
197	
198	/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) from its `ok` outcome, under
199	`DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
200	theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
201	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) : KInv s' := by
202	  cases op with
203	  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
204	  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
205	  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
206	  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
207	  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
208	  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
209	  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
210	  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
211	  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
212	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
213	  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
214	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
215	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
216	  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
217	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
218	  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h
219	
220	/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40,
221	§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
222	outcome. -/
223	theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
224	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
225	  cases op with
226	  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
227	  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
228	  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
229	  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
230	  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
231	  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
232	  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
233	  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
234	  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h
235	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_kAux haux h
236	  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
237	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
238	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
239	  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
240	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
241	  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
242	
243	/-- Every kernel step from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) under `DDSound` (§80) either preserves
244	`KInv` or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception (`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
245	theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
246	    (h : KStep k s s') : KInv s' ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') := by
247	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
248	  cases op with
249	  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
250	  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)
251	
252	/-- Every kernel step preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7) from a state satisfying `KInv`
253	(§57) and `KAux`. -/
254	theorem kstep_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
255	    (h : KStep k s s') : KAux s' := by
256	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
257	  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

259	/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/
260	
261	/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
262	(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
263	when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
264	private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
265	    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
266	      y.holder = .place q → x ∈ s'.D q ∨ ∃ y₀ : Authority, s.A[x]? = some y₀ ∧
267	        y₀.active = true ∧ y₀.origin ≠ none ∧ y₀.holder = .place q ∧
268	        (s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q → x ∈ s'.D q)) : HeldAnchored s' := by
269	  intro x y q hy ya ho hhq _
270	  rcases hstep x y q hy ya ho hhq with h | ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, ho₀, hh₀, himp⟩
271	  · exact h
272	  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this
273	    exact himp hu (hh x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh₀ hu)
274	
275	/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
276	`derive`, `split`, `enterFrame`, `alloc`). -/
277	private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
278	    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
279	  by_cases hx : x < l.length
280	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
281	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)
282	
283	/-- Every operation preserves `HeldAnchored` from a `WF3` state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new
284	authorities are held by frames or have no origin; `store` anchors what it stores (§65); a
285	`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
286	anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
287	places whose authorities stay active. -/
288	theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
289	    (hh : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
290	  cases op with
291	  | derive src region m =>
292	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
293	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
294	    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
295	    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
296	    · cases hhq
297	  | split src rs =>
298	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
299	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
300	    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
301	    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
302	    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; cases hhq
303	  | release a =>
304	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
305	    cases hx₀ : s.A[a]? with
306	    | none => simp only [releaseEff, hx₀]; exact hh
307	    | some x₀ =>
308	      rw [releaseEff_eq hx₀]
309	      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
310	      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx₀)] at hy
311	      split at hy
312	      · cases hy; cases ya
313	      · rename_i hax
314	        refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
315	        simp only
316	        split
317	        · exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, by simpa using fun e => hax e.symm⟩
318	        · exact hx
319	  | transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh h
320	  | depend q₀ x₀ =>
321	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
322	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq,
323	      fun _ hx => ?_⟩
324	    simp only [dependEff]
325	    split
326	    · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
327	    · exact hx
328	  | enter ps ls =>
329	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
330	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
331	    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
332	    · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy
333	      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
334	      split at e
335	      · subst e; cases hhq
336	      · subst e
337	        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
338	        show x ∈ (if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q)
339	        split
340	        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)
341	        · exact hx
342	    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
343	  | exit =>
344	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
345	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
346	    simp only [exitEff, getElem?_mapI, Nat.zero_add] at hy
347	    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
348	    unfold exitG at e
349	    split at e
350	    · rename_i hsv
351	      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by
352	        unfold Survives at hsv; rw [hy₀] at hsv; exact hsv.1
353	      split at e
354	      · subst e; exact absurd ‹_› ho
355	      · rename_i o ho₀
356	        subst e
357	        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, (by rw [ho₀]; exact fun h => by cases h), hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
358	        simp only [exitEff]
359	        refine List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
360	        show (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x = x
361	        rw [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (p := fun z => decide (Survives s s.F.tail z))
362	          (a := x) (decide_eq_true hsv)]
363	        rfl
364	    · subst e; cases ya
365	  | read a ls =>
366	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact hh
367	  | write a ls =>
368	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
369	    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
370	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
371	  | writeShared a ls =>
372	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
373	    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
374	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
375	  | pin p =>
376	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
377	    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
378	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
379	  | unpin p =>
380	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
381	    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
382	      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
383	  | endUse p =>
384	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
385	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
386	    obtain ⟨hy₀, hnh, -⟩ := EndFree.endUse_active hy ya
387	    refine .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
388	    rw [hhq] at hnh
389	    show x ∈ (if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q)
390	    split
391	    · exact absurd ‹_› hnh
392	    · exact hx
393	  | free p auth =>
394	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
395	    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
396	    obtain ⟨hy₀, -, -⟩ := EndFree.free_active hy ya
397	    exact .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
398	  | alloc pr ow ls =>
399	    cases h with
400	    | ok _ _ =>
401	      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
402	      rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
403	      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
404	        show x ∈ (if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q)
405	        split
406	        · exact absurd hu.lt (Nat.not_lt.2 ‹_›)

457	      rw [transfer_A_get, hx]; rfl

691	/-- A kernel step whose `transfer`, if it is one, leaves its destination usable (§63). The
692	condition is a hypothesis on runs, not a clause of §63 nor of §57. -/
693	def KStepDU (k : K) (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
694	  ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') ∧ ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst

696	/-- States reached from `S3.init statics` by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable
697	(§57, restricted by the hypothesis of `KStepDU`, which is not a clause of §63). -/
698	inductive ReachableDU (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
699	  /-- The initial state (§47). -/
700	  | init : ReachableDU k statics (S3.init statics)
701	  /-- One more step of `KStepDU` (§57). -/
702	  | step {s s' : S3} : ReachableDU k statics s → KStepDU k s s' → ReachableDU k statics s'
703

705	the steps of `KStepDU` are exactly the kernel steps whose resulting state satisfies `KInv`: the
706	restriction of `ReachableDU` keeps exactly the runs along which §57 holds. -/
707	theorem kstepDU_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
708	    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) : KStepDU k s s' ↔ KStep k s s' ∧ KInv s' := by
709	  constructor
710	  · rintro ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩
711	    exact ⟨kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩, (op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd hinv hheld hop hdu).1⟩
712	  · rintro ⟨h, hk⟩
713	    obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
714	    refine ⟨op, hop, fun src dst e => ?_⟩
715	    subst e
716	    exact transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling hinv.1 hop hk.2.1.2.2

718	/-- A state of `ReachableDU` is reachable (§57). -/
719	theorem ReachableDU.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
720	    (h : ReachableDU k statics s) : Reachable k statics s := by
721	  induction h with
722	  | init => exact .init
723	  | step _ h ih =>
724	    obtain ⟨op, hop, -⟩ := h
725	    exact .step ih (kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩)

729	`DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, a hypothesis not stated by §47). The
730	restriction of the runs is not a clause of §63: without it the statement is false
731	(`reachable_kinv_false`). -/
732	theorem reachableDU_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
733	    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : ReachableDU k statics s) :
734	    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
735	  induction h with
736	  | init => exact init_kinv hst
737	  | step _ h ih =>
738	    obtain ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩ := h
739	    have h' := op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 hop hdu
740	    exact ⟨h'.1, op_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 hop, h'.2⟩

744	/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
745	containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
746	corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
747	def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
748	  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls

# ERN — Memory Model Specification v0.1

**Edition v0.1 — corrective candidate, not yet validated**

Modified clauses, relative to v0 (each change is justified by a defect found while formalizing v0):

- §36: `MetaRight` governs authorities over existing storage, not the fresh allocation of `alloc`; §36 and §71.2 contradicted each other.
- §40: `RootHeld` restricted to usable root places, as in §49.7; the two clauses differed on unusable root places.
- §47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; a static ownership cycle made §57 false in the initial state.
- §51: a valid origin is an active origin; "valid" was undefined there.
- §57: definition of I5, which v0 named without defining.
- §59: "access operations" are O9–O11; read as all operations, §59 contradicted §69.
- §60.1: a valid origin chain is an active one, read through §44.
- §63.4: the active derived authorities covering the source from outside are named, and the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right are exempt; without this exemption no value could be moved through a derived authority.
- §63.9 (new): the destination is usable in the resulting state; without it an accepted transfer could create an ownership cycle and break §49.8 and §57.
- §69.2 and §70.3: the same exemption as §63.4, and rejection when an authority made inactive by the step keeps an active descendant; without it an accepted step left an active authority with an inactive origin.
- §71.2: the provider is a usable place; v0 did not require it to exist.
- §74 and §75: each `pin` installs an obligation of fresh identity and `unpin` ends one designated obligation; per-leaf pin flags let an `unpin` lift a pin installed by another `pin`.
- §76.6: the reading of the precondition (whole kernel state, `ArenaInv` of the new entry, resulting state); v0 admitted several readings with different verdicts.
- §78.3: restricted to anchors covering a leaf of the administered storage; as written, its second sentence was false.
- §82.2: address and provenance of a pointer to a region whose leaves all have zero physical size; v0 decided no address for that region.
- §86: the last sentence is rewritten; as written, it was false, since `reset` and `issue` leave a recycled leaf `Init` and readable.

This specification defines the normative rules of ERN's memory model. Technical names (`derive`, `transfer`, `issue`, etc.) designate **abstract semantic operations**; they do not constitute syntax decisions.

## 39. Execution Frames

`F` is a nonempty stack of identified, non-duplicate frames. Every frame except the initial frame knows its parent. Frames hold temporary authorities and directly local places. The **current frame** is at the top of the stack. `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` means `f₁` is `f₂` or an ancestor of `f₂` in the stack and its call chain.

The base frame, whose identity is 0 in states reachable from the initial state, never exits. An exited frame can neither be the terminal owner of a usable place nor hold an authority that remains active. Frames have semantic existence; no particular runtime representation is required.

## 40. Logical Places, Leaves, and Ownership

A place has an identity, optionally a structural parent, an abstract `kind`, an owner `owner : Frame | Place`, and a logical death marker. Structural parenthood `partOf(p,q)` describes the subplaces of a value; `owner` describes **who keeps the storage** of a root place valid. An owned place may lie outside its owner's direct footprint; ownership and composition are therefore distinct.

A **leaf** is a place with no structural children. `footprint(p)` contains the leaves of `p`, and access rights over a place are evaluated on those leaves. Places transitively owned by a value are not automatically leaves of its `footprint`. A logical unit of the access discipline does not automatically constitute an additional allocation in the elementary memory machine.

A place `p` is **usable** (`Usable(s,p)`) if and only if:

1. `p` exists and is not marked dead;
2. if its owner is a frame, that frame belongs to the stack;
3. if its owner is a place `q`, then `q` is itself usable and the chain terminates at a frame in the stack.

An ownership cycle makes no place usable. `placeFrame(p)` is the terminal frame of this chain when `p` is usable. Structural parts share their parent's owner and death marker. A value may be logically ended by `endUse` without the place that contained it becoming unusable; the substorages it owned may, however, die.

A **root place** has no structural parent. Every **usable** root place has a root authority of own mode `Modify`, with no origin, held exactly by that place's owner (`RootHeld`). This authority cannot be transferred in isolation; root ownership follows a legal transfer of the owning value when necessary.
## 47. Initial State

The kernel's initial state contains only base frame 0 and the declared static storage. Every static leaf has its declared initial state, `Init` or `Uninit`. The roots of static places directly owned by frame 0 have a root `Modify` authority held by that frame; a static may also be owned by another static, in which case its root authority is held by the latter. The ownership graph of statics is acyclic: no static is owned, directly or transitively, by itself. The initial state invents no dynamic allocation, derived authority, or implicit anchor. The initial arena registry belongs to library state and is empty. The initial frame does not exit.

## 48. External Parametric Contract

`K` contains the predicates `DeclaredDisjoint`, `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable`, `FreeCompat`, and `Satisfiable`. Their obligations are specified in Section 80. `K` can neither fabricate access rights nor remove an obligation of the Charter. The predicate `Invalidates` is not part of this contract.

# VII. Invariants of Reachable States

Machine states are subject to structural, validity, and exclusivity requirements preserved by permitted transitions under their declared external contracts.

## 57. Main Invariant

\[
Inv3 = I1 \land I2 \land I3 \land I4 \land AnchorOrder \land NoDangling
\]

On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees:

\[
WF3 \land Inv3 \land AnchorOrderHeld \land NoOrphan
\]

`ArenaInv` (Section 55) belongs to the library abstraction: it is not included in this main kernel invariant.

**I5:** every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning obligation, Section 74), belongs to a usable place.

I5, associated with pinned storage, remains a **specialized obligation** of `K.Pinned`, not a clause automatically implied by sequential accesses alone. This property is required for reachable states under the declared assumptions. Its correspondence with allocations and bytes requires the refinement defined below.

# VIII. Definition of Transitions and Management of Authorities

The following operations are abstract transition rules. They distinguish rejection by the discipline, defined failure, and a permitted transition.

## 58. Transition Outcomes

Every operation has a conceptual outcome among:

```text
Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail
```

`reject` means that the static discipline does not permit the step; it is neither an implicit runtime trap nor `ub` in the elementary memory machine. `fail` is a **defined failure** leaving the state unchanged; **only `alloc` may produce it in the O1–O16 kernel**. Other kernel operations produce `ok` or `reject`. Library-abstraction operations, including `issue` (§77), may define their own `fail` cases. Where such failure is provided, static preconditions are checked before dynamic availability, according to the operation's contract.

An `ok` transition must satisfy its preconditions, apply exactly its prescribed effects, and preserve the relevant invariants. No transition fabricates a permission to make its conclusion true. Holder and anchor changes are evaluated in the **resulting state** when a rule explicitly so provides.

## 59. Implicit Preservation of Modes and Anchors

Changes in effective authority are **derived** from active authorities and their origins; no `Suspended` indicator is mutated. Access operations (O9–O11) do not change an anchor without an explicitly authorized effect of transfer, `depend`, `store`, release, or reanchoring. Leaves becoming `Init` do so through a permitted write (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`, including during a derived `issue`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already `Init`; leaves initialized in `S3.init` are declared as such.

## 60. O1 — Derivation of an Authority

**Preconditions**

1. `source` is an active derived or root authority, and `ExercisableAt(s,source,mode)` holds; its origin chain and anchors are valid: every authority of its origin chain, its effective anchor included, is active.
2. The leaves of `region` exist and belong to the footprint of `source`; `mode` does not exceed the available effective right on these leaves.
3. The addition preserves exclusivity I1: no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible with the derived right, and already-active descendants are respected.
4. The new holding frame is the live current frame. The admissible state's footprint and anchoring restrictions remain true.

**`ok` effect:** A new active authority with fresh identity, origin `source`, requested mode and footprint, and held by the current frame is added. The source remains active; its effective modes are recomputed per leaf. No storage or place anchor is created. Multiple compatible observations remain permitted. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 61. O2 — Splitting Authorities

**Preconditions**
## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved. No active derived authority held outside `source` covers a source leaf, except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `source`: the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain. Other active authorities remain subject to this check.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.
9. **Destination usability:** `destination` is usable in the resulting state.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

## 64. O5 — Explicit Attachment of an Anchor
## 74. O15 — Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over the relevant leaves, and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations.

**`ok` effect:** A dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity is installed on the relevant leaves. A leaf is dynamically pinned while at least one active pinning obligation covers it. While an obligation is active, `transfer`, `endUse`, `free`, and `exitFrame` are rejected if they act on leaves it pins; removal of this obligation requires `unpin` under `K.ExternalDone`. Pinning does not make contents immutable. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 75. O16 — Removal of Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `unpin` designates one active dynamic pinning obligation, installed by `pin` on `place`; `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify`, and contract `K.ExternalDone`, applied to that obligation, attests that all relevant external use has ended.

**`ok` effect:** The designated dynamic pinning obligation ends, and only that one: a leaf it covered stays pinned while another active obligation covers it. The step does not itself modify values, their initialization, or their access authorities. Static obligations are not removed by this operation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

**Associated static rule (`StaticPinnedBottom`):** Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places **directly** owned by the **base frame**, not merely transitively owned by a static value. This restriction ensures that they do not die when an intermediate frame exits.

# XIV. Arenas and Collective Invalidation — Reference Abstraction
## 80. Parametric Contracts of the Access Discipline

A contract `K` parameterizes rules of the access discipline without fabricating permissions. A safe abstraction using part of `K` must prove or fulfill the corresponding obligation; an unestablished precondition is not a language guarantee.

| Contract | External obligation |
|---|---|
| `DeclaredDisjoint` | `DDSound(K)`: no falsely declared disjoint region when leaves can overlap |
| `Pinned` | I5, prohibition of incompatible physical moves; `StaticPinnedBottom` for pinned statics |
| `SharedMutable` | Applicable shared-mutation discipline, with correct rights and synchronization |
| `ExternalDone` | External use of storage has ended when `unpin` is permitted |
| `Deallocable` | The place belongs to a unit that can actually be freed |
| `FreeCompat` | Opaque deallocation authority is compatible with the unit being freed |
| `Satisfiable` | The provider can satisfy the requested shape **in the current state** |

Structural conditions of `free`, dependencies, and the derived library `reset` carry the relevant invalidation obligations. Physical justification of `DDSound` must be established by a realization consistent with memory layouts and Section 82.

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. A specialized obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a
conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) → ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Lemmas

/-!
# Access kernel: the preserved invariant

The conjunction that every kernel step must preserve (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`) and the auxiliary invariant carried with it. The per-operation preservation modules state their results with these two predicates.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The kernel invariant of §57: `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInv (s : S3) : Prop := WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s

/-- Auxiliary invariant carried with `KInv`, not a clause of §57 (§40, §49.7): the converse
root-holder property `RootHeldConv`, which is not a clause of `WF3`. -/
def KAux (s : S3) : Prop := RootHeldConv s

/-- `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3` (§54, §49.7), so `KInv` reduces to its first three
conjuncts. -/
theorem kInv_of {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3 s) (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : KInv s :=
  ⟨hw, hi, ha, noOrphan_of_wf3 hw⟩

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and `NoOrphan` (§57; §63, with §63.9). -/
theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ NoOrphan s' := by

/-- An accepted transfer preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7; §63 `ok`
effect, third item), with no further hypothesis. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (haux : KAux s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact transfer_rootHeldConv haux

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57 nor of §63: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)

  have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
  have ho₀ : y₀.origin ≠ none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src y₀.holder
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    cases e : y₀.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e] at hc; exact hc.elim

      rw [e] at hc hh

    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq

namespace TransferWitness

/-- Statics of the ownership-cycle counterexample (§47): two leaves owned by frame 0, place 0 and
place 1, both `Init`. -/
def cycStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of the counterexample (§47). -/
def cyc0 : S3 := S3.init cycStatics

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 0 (§71): place 2 owned by place 0, root
authority 2 held by place 0. -/
def cyc1 : S3 := allocEff cyc0 0 [(none, 0)]

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 2 (§71): place 3 owned by place 2, root
authority 3 held by place 2. -/
def cyc2 : S3 := allocEff cyc1 2 [(none, 0)]

/-- The effect of `transfer(0, 3)` on `cyc2` (§63 `ok` effect): place 2 would be owned by place 3,
which is owned by place 2. -/

  .step (.step .init (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 0) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))) (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 2) (ls := [(none, 0)])

/-- In `cyc3`, places 2 and 3 own each other and are unusable (§40; §63.9 fails); root authority
2 is active, held by the unusable place 3 and covers the leaf of the unusable place 2. -/

  obtain ⟨hu2, hu3, -, hy⟩ := cyc3_cycle

p='Main.lean'
s=open(p).read()
def rep(old,new):
    global s
    assert s.count(old)==1, old[:80]
    s=s.replace(old,new)

rep('''/-! ## Preservation by every step except `transfer` (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) from its `ok` outcome, under
`DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) : KInv s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
''','''/-! ## Preservation by every step (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv`
and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57, used by `transfer`, §63) to its `ok`
outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves hinv hheld h
''')

rep('''/-- Every kernel step from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) under `DDSound` (§80) either preserves
`KInv` or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception (`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : KInv s' ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)
''','''/-- Every operation preserves `I5` (§57: every leaf pinned statically or by an active obligation
of §74 belongs to a usable place) from a `WF3` state (§49) to its `ok` outcome. `WF3` is used by
`transfer` (§63.9), `endUse` (§69) and `free` (§70). -/
theorem op_preserves_i5 {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | split => exact split_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | release => exact release_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | read => exact read_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | write => exact write_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | free => exact free_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_i5 h5 h

exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
      y.holder = .place q → x ∈ s'.D q ∨ ∃ y₀ : Authority, s.A[x]? = some y₀ ∧
        y₀.active = true ∧ y₀.origin ≠ none ∧ y₀.holder = .place q ∧
        (s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q → x ∈ s'.D q)) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  intro x y q hy ya ho hhq _
  rcases hstep x y q hy ya ho hhq with h | ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, ho₀, hh₀, himp⟩
  · exact h
  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this
    exact himp hu (hh x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh₀ hu)

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`derive`, `split`, `enterFrame`, `alloc`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-- Every operation preserves `HeldAnchored` from a `WF3` state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new
authorities are held by frames or have no origin; `store` anchors what it stores (§65); a
`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
places whose authorities stay active. -/
theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
        · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
        · exact hx

/-- `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every kernel step from a `WF3` state (§44, §49, §57). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop
